verdict.rationale: Klaviyo has a documented MCP server that lets an AI agent act on Klaviyo data via natural language, and the API supports arbitrary schema-free data plus programmatic campaign creation, suggesting an agent could plausibly create segments too. However, no evidence pack item shows a segment-creation endpoint or an MCP example translating a plain-language audience description into an actual segment (the campaign example is the only concrete natural-language-to-action illustration). Missing for 10: explicit segment/API endpoint documentation, a worked example of natural-language-to-segment translation, and independent/hands-on confirmation this works in practice.
